International applicants

Review eligibility, document preparation and the application process for an English-taught degree at IBSC.

International admission guide

Prepare for an English-taught degree in strategic communication. Understand the applicant category, gather your documents and submit through YZU’s official application portal.

Check the applicant category

The standard international route includes foreign nationals who have never held R.O.C. nationality and do not have overseas Chinese student status when applying. Additional rules apply to other nationality, residence and prior-study histories.

Bachelor’s applicants need a high school qualification or recognized equivalent. Ask YZU’s Global Affairs Office to clarify your category if your history involves Taiwan, Hong Kong or Macau.

Compare admission pathways→Overseas compatriot guide→

Prepare your document folder

The official brochure lists the following application materials. The portal identifies the documents required for your program and situation.

  • High school diploma, or current enrollment evidence if you are graduating this year
  • Academic transcripts and any required ranking certificates
  • Passport cover and personal-data page
  • English proficiency evidence or the documented basis for an exemption
  • Autobiography or personal statement
  • Recent 2 × 2-inch headshot
  • Signed international admission affidavit
  • Financial evidence and, where applicable, a sponsorship letter
  • Any additional materials requested by the program

English and document preparation

The international brochure sets CEFR B1 or above for English-taught programs and describes exemption evidence. Documents outside Chinese or English require translations; admitted students must provide the verified originals required for registration.

Complete your application

Apply independently through YZU’s official system. Current intake dates and final document instructions appear in that system.

  • Confirm eligibility and choose the program in the official portal.
  • Complete the form, upload documents and follow the application-fee instructions.
  • Monitor email for requests about missing or incorrect information.
  • Check the admission result and reply to an offer within the stated period.
Apply in the official YZU portal (opens a new tab)↗Scholarships and support→

Domestic applicants

Explore Taiwan undergraduate admission routes and prepare for IBSC’s application and interview process.

Undergraduate admissions

Explore YZU’s undergraduate admission routes, then prepare for the route that applies to you. IBSC’s portfolio and interview guidance can help you explain your interests and achievements.

Choose your admission route

YZU publishes separate information for application admission (申請入學), Stars recommendation (繁星推薦) and examination distribution (分發入學). It also lists special selection, vocational-school selection, disability-specific admission, transfer admission and athletic admission.

  • Check the current department list and eligibility rules for your route.
  • For recommendation or distribution, review the department regulations and schedule for that route.
Explore the IBSC curriculum→

Complete each application step

For application admission, YZU’s second-stage notice separates fee payment, interview-slot selection and document upload. Follow each instruction and confirm completion.

  • Use YZU’s admission system to check payment details and results.
  • Upload and confirm the required review materials through the University Admissions Committee system.
  • Check the department interview schedule and bring the required original identity document.
Use the official YZU admission system (opens a new tab)↗Scholarships and support→

Keep your application current

The preparation examples above summarize YZU’s published 2026 guide. Your entry-year prospectus and interview notice determine the actual requirements, arrangements and dates. Contact the IBSC office if you have a question about program preparation.

Contact the program→Compare admission pathways→
Individual application information

Explore YZU’s undergraduate admission routes, then prepare for the route that applies to you. IBSC’s portfolio and interview guidance can help you explain your interests and achievements.

Prepare your learning portfolio

The 2026 preparation guide lists IBSC under 人文社會學院英語學士班, code 040112. It considers language and social-subject coursework, learning achievements, activities, motivation and international-learning interests. Applicants do not need every example listed in the preparation guide.

  • Choose clearly organized reports or practical work showing communication, public relations, strategic communication, society, culture or art.
  • Prepare an English reflection on activities and competitions; include language awards or certificates you hold.
  • Explain your study motivation and international-learning interests.

Prepare for the interview

The 2026 guide describes a group interview conducted mainly in English with Chinese support. Practise a clear English self-introduction and explain how your interests connect with the program.

  • Use specific examples to discuss your strengths, learning experiences and areas for improvement.
  • Review the current interview notice for the final arrangements.

Overseas compatriot applicants

Review guidance for overseas compatriot, Hong Kong and Macau applicants.

Overseas compatriot, Hong Kong and Macau guide

YZU offers a dedicated direct admission route for overseas compatriot, Hong Kong and Macau applicants. Start with your status and the evidence needed for review.

Understand the category

Eligibility depends on identity, residence history and education. The official guidance describes overseas compatriot students with overseas residence and permanent or long-term residence permission, and separate categories for Hong Kong and Macau residents.

Six-year residence conditions, exclusions and verification rules apply to relevant categories. The Global Affairs Office reviews your evidence; contact it if your nationality, household registration or study history needs clarification.

Compare admission pathways→International admission guide→

Gather evidence for your application

Prepare the items identified for your category in the current brochure and portal.

  • Identity documents, passport and relevant residence permission
  • Residence-history evidence where required
  • High school diploma or current enrollment certificate
  • Academic transcripts and required ranking certificates
  • Recent headshot and autobiography
  • The identity and education affidavit
  • Hong Kong or Macau eligibility confirmation where applicable
  • Other current-brochure appendices and personal-data agreement
  • Program-specific supporting materials, including language evidence where requested

Plan for document verification

Academic documents must follow the verification instructions for the place they were issued. Chinese or English translations are needed for documents in other languages. Graduating applicants must provide the diploma required before enrollment.

The 2027 first-round brochure lists IBSC as an English-taught bachelor’s program. Use the portal’s program entry when choosing your application.

Follow the direct application process

Current schedules and application details appear in the official portal.

  • Confirm your category and the program you wish to study.
  • Complete the official online form and upload the requested evidence.
  • Check email for document questions during the review.
  • Check your result in the system and reply to an offer within the required period.

Scholarships & support

Explore the program’s scholarship resources and the latest guidance from the university. Availability and requirements vary by scholarship and applicant category.

Scholarships and financial support

Explore the types of support described by IBSC and YZU. Your applicant category, entry year and the current award announcement determine the relevant rules.

Types of support

IBSC lists assistance for academic achievement, financial need, living expenses and unexpected hardship, together with awards for achievement in service, activities, talents and sports. External scholarships and grants are also listed.

  • Merit awards recognize academic performance.
  • Need-based and living assistance support students facing financial difficulty.
  • Emergency assistance addresses sudden hardship.
  • Activity and achievement awards recognize contributions beyond coursework.
  • External awards have their own eligibility and application requirements.

International and overseas compatriot students

For students entering from fall 2025, YZU’s published rules describe reimbursement categories of 20%, 50% and 100% of eligible tuition, miscellaneous and credit fees. Other charges, including accommodation, insurance and specified facility fees, are excluded.

Awards require review. Students must complete registration and pay the semester’s tuition and fees before scholarship disbursement.

Understand renewal conditions

The published undergraduate renewal criteria include completing a semester, taking the university’s minimum required credits, a conduct score of at least 80 and an average academic grade of at least 75. Departmental ranking is used for the 100% and 50% categories. Meeting a threshold does not itself confirm an award.

The rules distinguish new and current students and may differ by entry year. Check the award notice that applies to your own status.

Prepare for an application

The Student Affairs Office handles general scholarship questions. The Global Affairs Office publishes international and overseas compatriot award guidance.

  • Identify the scholarship category and the announcement for your status.
  • Check the application period and required evidence.
  • Prepare academic or financial documents specified by that award.
  • Submit through the named university unit and follow its review instructions.

A few useful answers

Is IBSC taught in English?

Yes. The official program website describes IBSC as a full English program.

Where can I find current application dates?

Follow the official admission guidance for your applicant category. Intake dates and document requirements can change.

Where is Yuan Ze University?

Yuan Ze University is in Zhongli District, Taoyuan City, Taiwan. The IBSC office is in Building 7, Room R70201.
